name: Watchman Joren
look: A gaunt border militiaman in a dented kettle-helm with soot smeared across both cheeks.
prop: A notched halberd and a cracked horn lantern.
line_first: Keep low by the gatehouse—their archers have the cobbled lane ranged to the inch.
line_return: Gate timbers are holding, barely. Tell Garrick we need iron wedges.

name: Clerk Oswin
look: A shivering middle-aged scribe clutching a wet wool cloak over ink-stained fingers.
prop: A brass-bound tally slate and a broken padlock.
line_first: Three months of river tariffs sank in that ditch! Don't let the gnolls chew the box.
line_return: If the silver's gone, Thornwick's militia won't stay past sundown.

name: Peat-Cutter Mara
look: A wiry woman wrapped in greased horsehide with mud dried up to her thighs.
prop: A long iron-shod peat spade.
line_first: Step only on the black tussocks—green moss hides sinkholes deep enough to swallow a horse.
line_return: Keep your torches hooded; bog-lights draw things with teeth.

name: Runner Talia
look: A breathless young outrider with a blood-soaked bandage wrapped around her left calf.
prop: An empty leather dispatch tube.
line_first: The bone totems in the pines are feeding their wards—burn them before night falls!
line_return: My leg won't carry me back up the ridge, so make every arrow count.

name: Sawyer Dobb
look: A broad-shouldered woodcutter missing two fingers, wearing a sawdust-caked leather apron.
prop: A two-man crosscut saw slung over one shoulder.
line_first: Tarn's turncoats locked our best iron axes inside the central timber shed.
line_return: Burn their pork barrels, just leave the seasoned oak planks intact.

name: Warden Hale
look: A sun-darkened ranger in salt-stiffened rawhide with a cracked spyglass hung at his neck.
prop: A curved horn-bow and a bundle of signal flags.
line_first: Dust storms roll off the basin without warning—keep horns close or lose half your column.
line_return: The ridge blinds are clear for now, though raiders still prowl the dry arroyos.

name: Miner Tomas
look: A stocky quarryman covered in black ironstone dust with raw chain-chafes around his wrists.
prop: A heavy steel quarry-pick.
line_first: Break the slave-pen locks on the middle terrace and three hundred picks join your line!
line_return: Gorrathul's overseers hid the hoist keys in the pit—bury them.

name: Drover Vane
look: A one-eyed caravan driver with cracked lips and a salt-crusted felt hat.
prop: A braided rawhide mule-whip.
line_first: My lead mules bolted when the sand-raiders whistled—help me haul these crates off the flats!
line_return: Never trust a dry creek bed at noon; lurkers sleep two inches under the crust.

name: Surveyor Nira
look: An indigo-robed scholar squinting through smoked-quartz spectacles against blowing grit.
prop: A brass plumb-bob and charcoal rubbing-pad.
line_first: The quartz spire is cracking! Kill the blood-chanters before the static cooks us alive!
line_return: Keep those rubbings dry—Zahra will need every glyph on that parchment.

name: Sentry Kell
look: A hollow-cheeked pikeman leaning heavily on a spear beside a chained iron well-cover.
prop: A battered copper ladle.
line_first: One drop of beetle-bile ruins a whole cistern—keep those scourges off the stone rim!
line_return: Water's rationed to half a pint till Bram's wagons reach the gate.

name: Corporal Brenn
look: A salt-cured infantry corporal in a rusted breastplate with seaweed tangled in his greaves.
prop: A notched boarding-axe.
line_first: Watch the tide-lines—heavy mail sinks like an anchor when the surf rolls over the spit!
line_return: Hold the plank-walk; Oakhaven's marines are right behind you.

name: Pilot Maren
look: A weather-beaten coast pilot in oiled yellow canvas with brass dividers tucked in his sash.
prop: A salt-stained sounding lead and line.
line_first: You have two hours before spring tide floods the lower ward—move fast or drown in plate!
line_return: Keep off the kelp-slick steps; one slip drops you straight into the sluice.

name: Apothecary Linn
look: A pale apprentice surgeon in a vinegar-soaked apron with blood dried under her fingernails.
prop: A wicker tray of boiled linen rolls.
line_first: Keep those cleaver-happy raiders off the tent ropes—half our wounded can't even crawl!
line_return: Sera's loading the last stretchers now; hold the creek trail ten more minutes.

name: Lock-Keeper Orin
look: A grease-stained canal mechanic with a swollen bruised shoulder and a heavy iron wrench.
prop: A three-foot iron gear-wedge.
line_first: Drive these wedges into the center capstan before their sappers trip the floodgates!
line_return: Those gears won't turn again this winter—the east bridge is safe.

name: Fire-Warden Cole
look: A soot-blackened dockworker coughing through a wet wool scarf tied over his nose.
prop: A hooked fire-pike and sand bucket.
line_first: Pitch-pots are raining off Kael's flagship—clear the seawall stairs so we can douse the piers!
line_return: Save the drydocks first; without hulls, we never cross the southern straits.

name: Ash-Scout Riven
look: A lean vanguard scout in soot-grey leather with smoked-glass goggles pushed onto his forehead.
prop: A bundle of white-chalked warning stakes.
line_first: Stay off the yellow crust—boiling sulfur sits two inches beneath that brittle shell!
line_return: Highcrest bluff is clear, though the ash-storms are thickening to the east.

name: Sapper Garr
look: A squat, burn-scarred engineer wearing thick leather welding gauntlets and an iron visor.
prop: A keg of black prism-powder.
line_first: Cover my team while we set the charges on the West Conduit—one spark ends us early!
line_return: Charges are primed; clear the dais before the stone splits.

name: Watchman Varo
look: A exhausted Greystone defender in cracked basalt-dusted plate with a sling on his left arm.
prop: A heavy steel windlass crossbow.
line_first: Three demonic catapults are chewing our east parapet to gravel—sally out and burn them!
line_return: Parapet's patched with pumice mortar, though my ears are still ringing.

name: Penitent Sola
look: A barefoot ash-robed witness carrying a chain of tarnished brass name-plates.
prop: A small iron censer smoking with grey ash.
line_first: Speak softly in the nave—the First Watch still stands bound to those obsidian pillars.
line_return: Two doors, two prices. Choose which temperature you want for Thornvael.

name: Stoker Brann
look: A shirtless, keloid-scarred forge-hand wearing a heavy asbestos-lined leather apron.
prop: Long iron crucible tongs.
line_first: Vok needs slag-billets from the lower vents before we can re-temper your vanguard's shields!
line_return: Keep your steel oiled; volcanic fumes pit bare iron in half an hour.

name: Ferryman Garren
look: A stooped river-man in a tarred leather jerkin with rope-calloused hands and milky eyes.
prop: A ten-foot ashwood punt-pole and a rusted tin bailer.
line_first: Bridge is out upstream, and the toll-brigands watch the shallow gravel. Pay a silver if you want dry knees.
line_repeat: Current's running strong today; keep your armor strapped tight in the skiff.
line_farewell: Mind the sunken pilings on the far bank.
line_return: Current's running strong today; keep your armor strapped tight in the skiff.

name: Peddler Merrin
look: A wiry trader bent beneath a towering wicker pack clanking with pots, tallow, and dried herbs.
prop: A gnarled walking staff notched with mile-marks.
line_first: Even the highwaymen rarely rob a man carrying turnips and boot-grease—too heavy to run with!
line_repeat: Need spare bowstrings or oilskin? Better buy before you reach the fens.
line_farewell: Keep your coin pouch inside your shirt, friend.
line_return: Need spare bowstrings or oilskin? Better buy before you reach the fens.

name: Corporal Vane
look: A hollow-cheeked pikeman missing one boot, wearing a muddy cloak with torn royal insignia.
prop: A snapped pike-shaft used as a crutch.
line_first: They sent twenty of us to hold a flooded ditch without rations. I chose mud over a grave.
line_repeat: If you see Thornwick patrols, tell them Vane drowned at the ford.
line_farewell: Don't die for lords who can't spell your name.
line_return: If you see Thornwick patrols, tell them Vane drowned at the ford.

name: Mother Tilda
look: An elderly woman in a homespun shawl stained green at the cuffs from crushed river-mint.
prop: A woven rush basket brimming with muddy roots.
line_first: Chew white willow bark when the river-chill gets in your joints—keeps the shaking fever off.
line_repeat: The reeds grow thicker every year where blood was spilled.
line_farewell: Walk softly by the creek-banks, child.
line_return: The reeds grow thicker every year where blood was spilled.

name: Brother Aldous
look: A barefoot penitent wrapped in coarse burlap, his forehead smudged with gray river-ash.
prop: A carved wooden rosary and a battered tin alms-bowl.
line_first: I walk the old border stones to pray for those who fell before the Compact broke.
line_repeat: No shrine stands untouched by greed, yet the stones still remember.
line_farewell: May the Shepherd watch your steps.
line_return: No shrine stands untouched by greed, yet the stones still remember.

name: Tinker Pip
look: A soot-speckled youth wearing spectacles mended with copper wire and a scorched leather apron.
prop: A portable charcoal brazier and a ring of iron tongs.
line_first: Cracked kettle? Bent buckle? Give me ten minutes and a pinch of flux, good as forged!
line_repeat: I stay close to the crossroads—soldiers always break something.
line_farewell: Don't let your blade go dry in this mist!
line_return: I stay close to the crossroads—soldiers always break something.

name: Digger Marn
look: A broad-shouldered bogman caked to the waist in black mud, squinting through a cloud of midges.
prop: A long-handled iron turf-spade.
line_first: Dug up three rusted helmets and a pickled hand before noon. Redmarsh never lets go of anything.
line_repeat: Keep to the white-marked stakes unless you fancy sinking to your chin.
line_farewell: Watch the green lights after sundown.
line_return: Keep to the white-marked stakes unless you fancy sinking to your chin.

name: Old Reed-Eyes
look: A skeletal recluse draped in woven sedge-mats, his beard tangled with dried duckweed.
prop: A crooked driftwood crook hung with dried frog-skins.
line_first: Civilization rots faster than bog-oak. Out here, at least the monsters don't levy taxes.
line_repeat: The mire-heretics chant at midnight; plug your ears with beeswax.
line_farewell: Tread light, flesh-bag.
line_return: The mire-heretics chant at midnight; plug your ears with beeswax.

name: Master Corvus
look: A gaunt physician in a waxed oilcloth coat and a wide-brimmed hat stuffed with dried wormwood.
prop: A wooden crate clinking with stoppered glass leech-jars.
line_first: Swamp-bloat kills more mercenaries than steel! My leeches draw the black humor right out.
line_repeat: Never scratch a bog-fly bite; rub it with bitter-root paste.
line_farewell: Keep your boots greased and your mouth shut.
line_return: Never scratch a bog-fly bite; rub it with bitter-root paste.

name: Surveyor Fenwick
look: A mud-splattered scholar clutching a waterproof leather scroll-case against his chest.
prop: A brass sighting-level and a knotted measuring cord.
line_first: Half the roads on the royal map sank three winters ago! I'm redrawing the dikes before another column drowns.
line_repeat: If you spot solid stone ruins, mark them for me—everything else is shifting peat.
line_farewell: Trust your eyes, not old parchment.
line_return: If you spot solid stone ruins, mark them for me—everything else is shifting peat.

name: Raker Nell
look: A wiry woman in patched waders with a necklace of tarnished buckles and salvaged buttons.
prop: A long wooden pole fitted with a three-pronged iron grapple.
line_first: You fight the ghouls, I fish their pockets out of the silt—fair division of labor, wouldn't you say?
line_repeat: Nothing's truly lost in Redmarsh if your grappling hook is long enough.
line_farewell: Leave the shiny bits if you fall, eh?
line_return: Nothing's truly lost in Redmarsh if your grappling hook is long enough.

name: Penitent Garr
look: A wild-eyed fanatic wearing a spiked iron collar over scarred, mud-streaked shoulders.
prop: A knotted hemp scourge stained dark.
line_first: The Mire is our purgatory! Only through cold mud and bitter pain are our sins washed clean!
line_repeat: Do not strike the heretics with anger—pity their blindness!
line_farewell: Endure the mire, traveler.
line_return: Do not strike the heretics with anger—pity their blindness!

name: Diver Sal
look: A barrel-chested coastal woman with salt-bleached hair and scars from barnacle cuts across both forearms.
prop: A greased seal-bladder float and a heavy iron pry-bar.
line_first: Three royal pay-ships went down off these reefs last gale. Corsairs get the decks; I get the holds.
line_repeat: Watch the tide-pools—reef-stalkers nest under the rusted hulls.
line_farewell: Keep high ground when the wind shifts east.
line_return: Watch the tide-pools—reef-stalkers nest under the rusted hulls.

name: Raker Orin
look: A sun-baked laborer with cracked lips, squinted eyes, and boots crusted white with dried brine.
prop: A wide wooden salt-scraper.
line_first: Royal taxmen take nine bushels of salt out of ten, and leave us to fend off pirates with wooden rakes.
line_repeat: Fresh water's worth twice as much as grog along this stretch of cliff.
line_farewell: Don't let the salt-zealots catch you alone.
line_return: Fresh water's worth twice as much as grog along this stretch of cliff.

name: Kaelo the Free
look: A muscular man bearing raw iron-shackle scars on both wrists and a stolen corsair sash.
prop: A broken galley-oar bound with iron bands.
line_first: Rowed for Draven's raiders four years before a reef cracked our keel. Never wearing chains again.
line_repeat: If you spot a slaver patrol, hit the whip-master first—the rest scatter.
line_farewell: Fair winds to your back, friend.
line_return: If you spot a slaver patrol, hit the whip-master first—the rest scatter.

name: Warden Mirella
look: A wind-worn ranger wrapped in gull-gray wool with a thick leather gauntlet reaching her elbow.
prop: A hooded sea-hawk perched on a driftwood T-bar.
line_first: My bird spots corsair sails three leagues out. Right now, two longboats are hugging the southern cove.
line_repeat: Cliff-harpies hate falcons—keeps them off my perch, at least.
line_farewell: Watch the sky above the basalt crags.
line_return: Cliff-harpies hate falcons—keeps them off my perch, at least.

name: Old Barto
look: A hunchbacked sailor sitting on an upturned tar barrel, fingers flying through knotted hemp twine.
prop: A bone netting-needle and a coil of tarred cord.
line_first: Used to haul silver cod by the ton. Now half the time we pull up drowned bones or barnacle-crabs.
line_repeat: Never cast a net near the Abyssal Pool unless you want something pulling back.
line_farewell: Steady footing on the wet rocks.
line_return: Never cast a net near the Abyssal Pool unless you want something pulling back.

name: Keeper Torin
look: A pale, gaunt old man smelling strongly of whale-oil and damp wool, squinting against the daylight.
prop: A brass oil-can and a heavy ring of iron tower keys.
line_first: Without whale-oil for the beacon, ships pile onto the teeth every night—and wreckers cheer.
line_repeat: The sea takes everything we build; we just pile stones back up.
line_farewell: Follow the cliff-markers after dark.
line_return: The sea takes everything we build; we just pile stones back up.

name: Sweeper Dax
look: A coughing worker wrapped in gray rags with a wet cloth tied tightly over his nose and mouth.
prop: A wide iron coal-shovel and a creaking wooden handcart.
line_first: They pay two coppers a barrow to clear cinders off the royal road. Still cheaper than hiring soldiers.
line_repeat: Don't kick the gray drifts—hot embers hide underneath for days.
line_farewell: Breathe shallow near the foundries.
line_return: Don't kick the gray drifts—hot embers hide underneath for days.

name: Scribe Malen
look: A trembling former court clerk in singed velvet robes, clutching half-burned tax rolls to his chest.
prop: A cracked inkhorn and a bundle of charred vellum.
line_first: When the Inquisitor ordered the archives burned, I ran with the real debt-ledgers. Now I'm a dead man walking.
line_repeat: Every noble in the capital owes blood-gold to the Cinder Throne.
line_farewell: Burn my name if they catch me.
line_return: Every noble in the capital owes blood-gold to the Cinder Throne.

name: Sergeant Thorne
look: A scarred heavy infantryman in blackened plate with the royal crest hammered flat off his breastplate.
prop: A notched tower shield and a dented water-canteen.
line_first: I served the Crown twenty years until they ordered us to torch our own granaries. Let the Sovereign choke on his ashes.
line_repeat: Pyre-knights fight blind inside those heavy helms—strike their knees.
line_farewell: Give the Throne my regards in steel.
line_return: Pyre-knights fight blind inside those heavy helms—strike their knees.

name: Sister Vesper
look: A soot-stained medic wearing scorched linen bandages around her forearms and a pouch of grease-pots.
prop: A wooden mortar and a tin flask of goose-fat salve.
line_first: Crown-fire blisters through boiled leather in seconds. Rub mutton-tallow on your skin before you face them.
line_repeat: Water's scarcer than silver out here; don't waste a drop washing your face.
line_farewell: Stay out of the brazier-smoke.
line_return: Water's scarcer than silver out here; don't waste a drop washing your face.

name: Vex the Ash-Runner
look: A lean rogue in a reversible charcoal cloak with soot smeared deliberately across his brow.
prop: A lead-lined lockbox slung over one shoulder.
line_first: Rich lords pay fortunes to sneak family heirlooms out of the capital before the whole city turns to slag.
line_repeat: Inquisitors search wagons, never ash-carts.
line_farewell: Keep to the shadows of the viaduct.
line_return: Inquisitors search wagons, never ash-carts.

name: Old Cinder-Tongue
look: A wild-haired old man in scorched rags pointing a blackened finger toward the smoking citadel.
prop: A cracked bronze hand-bell without a clapper.
line_first: Gold melts, iron bends, flesh chars—only the ash remains equal under the Sovereign's sky!
line_repeat: Listen to the wind through the viaducts; it sings the requiem of kings!
line_farewell: We all meet in the dust!
line_return: Listen to the wind through the viaducts; it sings the requiem of kings!

name: Surveyor Hal
look: A frostbitten boundary-clerk in a patched sheepskin coat, squinting through cracked brass spectacles.
prop: A leather map-case and a bent plumb-line.
line_first: My apprentice bolted when the stone sentinels woke—grab that brass sighting glass before the snow hides it.
line_return: Not a scratch on the lens! Now Thornwick can draw an honest road map.

name: Foreman Durn
look: A broad-shouldered dwarven shift-boss with coal-grimed knuckles and a notched iron pick-helve.
prop: A dented brass shift-whistle and a copper-bound tally board.
line_first: Cultists locked the shift-office before we could haul out the paychest. Cut the warden down and crack that door.
line_return: Every silver bit accounted for. The crew remembers who kept their wages out of cultist hands.
